welcome.headline: Make sound
welcome.body: A free, open-source workspace for recording, arranging, and mixing music on Windows, macOS, and Linux.
welcome.newProjectBody: Open an empty timeline and make the first sound.
welcome.noRecent: Your recent projects will appear here when you start creating.

midi.title: General
midi.description: Choose how MIDI pitches are labeled across the piano roll and editors.

centerC.title: Center C
centerC.description: Pick the manufacturer octave standard used for middle C (MIDI note 60).

yamaha.label: Yamaha (C3)
yamaha.description: Middle C is labeled C3, matching Yamaha keyboards and many Japanese products.

roland.label: Roland (C4)
roland.description: Middle C is labeled C4, matching Roland gear and scientific pitch notation.

display.title: General
display.description: Choose a comfortable workspace for long editing and mixing sessions.
display.themeDescription: Changes apply immediately across every project and are remembered on this device.

light.label: Light
light.description: A soft neutral-gray workspace for bright rooms.

dark.label: Dark
dark.description: Low-glare graphite surfaces for long sessions.

system.label: Follow system
system.description: Switch automatically with your operating system.

display.languageDescription: Menus, dialogs, mixer, studio, and settings copy update immediately across the app.

plugins.title: Audio plug-ins
plugins.description: Review the plug-ins Heron discovered and rebuild the catalog after installing or removing one.

catalog.title: Catalog status
catalog.description: Heron scans at launch and reuses unchanged plug-in fingerprints to keep startup fast.

discovery.title: Plug-in discovery
discovery.description: Force a fresh scan of all VST3 and CLAP locations, including quarantined plug-ins.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard & MIDI shortcuts
shortcuts.description: Assign keyboard combinations, MIDI notes, and MIDI control-change messages to application commands.
shortcuts.instructions: Select a keyboard binding and press the new combination, or use MIDI Learn and move a hardware control.
shortcuts.groupDescription: Keyboard and MIDI bindings are stored for this device.

mock.label: Mock
mock.description: Runs the engine without real audio devices

devices.title: Devices
devices.description: Choose the host API, audio devices, and real-time I/O buffer.

backend.title: Backend
backend.description: Select the host API used by the native audio engine.
backend.unavailable: No CPAL audio backend is available.
backend.hostUnavailable: This CPAL host is not available in the current native build.
backend.noHostReported: CPAL did not report an available audio host.

output.title: Output device
output.description: Select the CPAL device used for monitoring and playback.

input.title: Input device
input.description: Select the CPAL device used for recording.

buffer.title: I/O buffer size
buffer.description: Smaller buffers reduce latency but require more CPU headroom.

latency.title: Latency
latency.description: Reported by the running Rust engine from CPAL timestamps and the live ring-buffer fill.

roundTrip.label: Round-trip latency
roundTrip.detail: ADC → input → ring → graph → output → DAC

loopbackSection.title: Physical loopback
loopbackSection.description: Measure actual hardware round-trip latency with a direct output-to-input cable.

engine.title: Runtime scheduling
engine.description: Bound embedded runtime concurrency without changing the real-time callback. Changes take effect the next time the application starts.

workerThreads.title: Async worker threads
workerThreads.description: Runs protocol, engine, background I/O and telemetry tasks. VST3 stays thread-affine.

blockingThreads.title: Blocking thread ceiling
blockingThreads.description: Caps plug-in loading, file I/O and other controlled blocking jobs.

recording.title: Recording
recording.description: Capture stays in machine-local swap until a successful project archive save.

swapDirectory.title: Swap directory
swapDirectory.description: Half-finished recordings and recoverable source BWF files live here.

bitDepth.title: Final bit depth
bitDepth.description: Swap is always float32. Integer output is dithered once after resampling.

softwareMonitoring.title: Software monitoring
softwareMonitoring.description: Hear hardware inputs through the track's effects, fader, pan, sends, delay compensation, and output routing.
softwareMonitoring.warning: Use headphones or mute direct monitoring on the audio interface. Open speakers can create loud feedback.
softwareMonitoring.enabled: Available on Audio tracks with hardware inputs.
softwareMonitoring.disabled: Off. Existing per-track monitoring choices are preserved.

lowLatencyBudget.title: Low-latency plug-in budget
lowLatencyBudget.description: Maximum declared plug-in latency allowed on a live monitoring main path before eligible effects are temporarily bypassed.

recovery.title: Recovery
recovery.description: Files are never removed merely because the project was closed without saving.

mixerDisplay.title: Mixer meters
mixerDisplay.description: Control how channel peaks remain visible and return after transients.

peakHold.title: Peak hold time
peakHold.description: Keeps the highest level visible long enough to identify short transients.

returnRate.title: Return time
returnRate.description: Sets how quickly the displayed level falls after the signal peak.
